What does the free plan include?+

One domain, one mailbox and 1 GB of storage, with one sending address and up to three receive-only aliases. Paid plans include unlimited aliases and alternate sending addresses. There is no age-based message expiry. Sending requires domain verification and approval, and is subject to sending limits. Compare every plan on the pricing page.

Is the price per person or per account?+

Per account. Each plan includes a stated number of mailboxes, domains and shared storage. There is no separate per-user charge within those limits. See what that saves a team in our business email guide.
